objective: Auditar la causa de los 12 días desfasados de 130MID febrero 2026 comparando Runtime V2 contra el POS SoftRestaurant actual por turnos.apertura, y revisar configuración operativa de la unidad. No modificar datos ni Producción.

queries.name: soft_130mid_feb_by_turn_apertura
queries.sql:
SELECT
            CONVERT(date,tr.apertura) AS fecha_apertura,
            SUM(CAST(ISNULL(ch.total,0) AS decimal(18,2))) AS venta,
            COUNT(DISTINCT ch.folio) AS tickets,
            SUM(CAST(ISNULL(ch.nopersonas,0) AS bigint)) AS pax,
            MIN(tr.apertura) AS apertura_min,
            MAX(tr.apertura) AS apertura_max
          FROM cheques ch WITH (NOLOCK)
          INNER JOIN turnos tr WITH (NOLOCK) ON tr.idturno=ch.idturno
          WHERE tr.apertura>='2026-02-01' AND tr.apertura<'2026-03-01'
            AND ISNULL(ch.cancelado,0)=0
          GROUP BY CONVERT(date,tr.apertura)
          ORDER BY fecha_apertura

queries.name: soft_130mid_boundary_turns_16_17_21_22
queries.sql:
SELECT
            tr.idturno,
            tr.apertura,
            tr.cierre,
            SUM(CAST(ISNULL(ch.total,0) AS decimal(18,2))) AS venta,
            COUNT(DISTINCT ch.folio) AS tickets,
            SUM(CAST(ISNULL(ch.nopersonas,0) AS bigint)) AS pax,
            MIN(ch.fecha) AS cheque_fecha_min,
            MAX(ch.fecha) AS cheque_fecha_max,
            MIN(ch.cierre) AS cheque_cierre_min,
            MAX(ch.cierre) AS cheque_cierre_max
          FROM turnos tr WITH (NOLOCK)
          INNER JOIN cheques ch WITH (NOLOCK) ON ch.idturno=tr.idturno
          WHERE tr.apertura>='2026-02-16' AND tr.apertura<'2026-02-23'
            AND ISNULL(ch.cancelado,0)=0
          GROUP BY tr.idturno,tr.apertura,tr.cierre
          ORDER BY tr.apertura

queries.name: soft_130mid_zero_total_problem_days
queries.sql:
SELECT
            CONVERT(date,tr.apertura) AS fecha_apertura,
            COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ISNULL(ch.total,0)=0 THEN ch.folio END) AS tickets_total_cero,
            SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(ch.total,0)=0 THEN ISNULL(ch.nopersonas,0) ELSE 0 END) AS pax_total_cero
          FROM cheques ch WITH (NOLOCK)
          INNER JOIN turnos tr WITH (NOLOCK) ON tr.idturno=ch.idturno
          WHERE tr.apertura>='2026-02-01' AND tr.apertura<'2026-03-01'
            AND ISNULL(ch.cancelado,0)=0
          GROUP BY CONVERT(date,tr.apertura)
          ORDER BY fecha_apertura

queries.name: runtime_130mid_feb2026
queries.sql:
SELECT CAST(fecha_operacion AS date) AS fecha_operacion,
                     CAST(ventas_total AS decimal(18,2)) AS ventas_total,
                     tickets_total,
                     pax_total,
                     sync_run_id,
                     fecha_ultima_actualizacion
              FROM dbo.Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2
              WHERE unidad_negocio_id='130MID'
                AND fecha_operacion>='2026-02-01'
                AND fecha_operacion<'2026-03-01'
              ORDER BY fecha_operacion

queries.name: turnos_operativos_130mid
queries.sql:
SELECT *
              FROM dbo.Sistema_TurnosOperativosUnidad
              WHERE UPPER(CONVERT(varchar(100),UnidadNegocioID))='130MID'
                 OR UPPER(CONVERT(varchar(100),UnidadCodigo))='130MID'
              ORDER BY 1
